accounting.basis: Completion-received clock. Author/provider times nested, never added to each other. Classification, visual and selection windows include non-provider work; they are not exact model timings.
accounting.residualMeaning: Arithmetic remainder, not an independently measured stage or provider cost. Includes auth, routing outside the classification window, tool/API handoffs, source/final reads outside visual windows, persistence/capture, SSE/network scheduling. Cross-clock timestamps have small observation skew.

retryCounts.rule: At most two content attempts per exact source/final; still unconfirmed after two degrades and records. Distinct revised bytes are separately identified check groups. Visual batches have no retry loop.

limitations: The initial GPT-4o classification is a separate model call: only its 1147 ms enclosing window is retained, not response bytes or exact provider duration. The following briefing is fixed text, not another generation.

Successful selection response byte counts and exact provider elapsed times were not retained. All observed selection starts and enclosing windows are included; missing is not zero.
